name: Status badge
summary: One 22px badge for a status (a dot, an icon or no marker before the label) and for neutral information that is not a status.
highlights: Four looks: published, draft, closed, archived
Marker: a dot, an icon or none, never mixed in one dimension
Default badge for counters and types
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-status-badge>, for every badge that reports a state. The box never changes: 22px tall, 8px side padding, 6px radius, a 12px semibold label and a 6px gap. `status` is a built-in state that picks its own look and marker: the lifecycle states (draft, published, closed, archived, active, inactive) carry a 6px dot; the progress states carry an icon in place of the dot (completed, in-progress) or no marker (not-started). `look` dresses a state that has no built-in status in one of the four looks, and `look="default"` is the neutral badge for information that is not a status (a counter, a slide type), with or without an icon and never with a dot. Inside one status dimension (a column, a list, a card slot) use dots only, or icons and no marker only, never both. The label is your slotted text and is always present; the marker is decorative. Shadow-DOM CSS on one persistent node, themed only by --aha-* tokens; role="status" with an aria-label mirrored from the label.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React and Vue set attributes on the custom element directly. Importing the element also registers <aha-icon>, which draws the icon marker. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Box
spec.value: height 22 · padding 0 8 · radius sm 6 · label 12/18 semibold 600 · gap 6

spec.label: Marker
spec.value: dot 6 × 6, or a 12px icon from the registry in the label colour, or none

spec.value: background bgAccent #FEF3F7 · text textLink #E70E68 · dot vivid-pink-100 #E70E68

spec.label: Archived
spec.value: background Gray 25 #F3F3F3 · text textDisabled #B5B5B5 · dot iconDisabled #B5B5B5

spec.label: Default
spec.value: background Gray 35 #EBEBEB · text textDefault #1A1A1A · no dot, optional icon

spec.label: Built-in status
spec.value: active → published look · inactive → archived look · completed → published look + system-check · in-progress → closed look + system-hourglass-high · not-started → draft look, no marker

spec.label: App colours
spec.value: --aha-status-badge-bg and --aha-status-badge-fg replace the background and the label colour; the box stays. The DS ships no hue for status

props.name: status
props.type: draft | published | closed | archived | active | inactive | not-started | in-progress | completed
props.desc: A built-in state. It picks its own look and marker: the six lifecycle states show a dot, completed a check icon, in-progress an hourglass icon, not-started no marker

props.name: look
props.desc: The look for a state with no built-in status (Invited, Joined, Removed). default is the neutral badge for information that is not a status, and never shows a dot

props.name: marker
props.default: from status; icon when icon is set; else dot
props.desc: What sits before the label. Use one family per status dimension: dots only, or icons and none only

props.name: icon
props.desc: A 12px glyph from the DS icon registry, drawn in the label colour in place of the dot. Decorative: the label carries the meaning

props.name: --aha-status-badge-bg
props.desc: App-supplied background. Only for a colour set the app already owns (Report results); never to give a DS status a hue

props.name: --aha-status-badge-fg
props.desc: App-supplied label and icon colour, paired with --aha-status-badge-bg

whenToUse.when: the state of a domain object from a known enum: lifecycle (published, draft, closed, archived), progress (completed, in progress, not started) or membership (invited, joined, removed)
read-only information about the object that is not a status and sits where badges sit: a counter (4/6), a slide or question type with its icon, Unanswered or Time out with an icon
a free-form label, keyword or category the user adds, removes or filters by (closable, checkable)
a count bubble or notification dot on another element, a plan chip
a due date or deadline: plain text, in the primary colour only when it needs attention (due soon, overdue), not highlighted when on time

opinion.note: Never mix marker families in one status dimension: a column, a list or a card slot shows dot badges only, or icon and no-marker badges only. Keep the text label on every badge; the dot or icon is decorative and never the only signal. Set the look through status or look, never by restyling the part. The two colour custom properties exist so an app can keep a colour set it already owns inside the shared box; they are not a way to add a hue to a DS status.
opinion.dsv3: This is the reusable form of the status-badges guideline (guidelines/status-badges.json). The four looks and the box were agreed in DESY-181; the DS colour rules give status no hue, so there is no green, red or amber look. A scheduled state is not defined yet: add a translation key and choose one of the four looks.
